test_title: PYST 3: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The chant included a solemn **sursum** near the offertory.

options.text: The musicologist analyzed the sursum tones in Gregorian chant.
The botanist labeled the root as sursum-curving.
The cantor raised his arms at the sursum.
The choir followed the rubric leading into the sursum.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"sursum"** in the context of the question refers to a part of a chant in liturgical settings, often associated with solemn or uplifting moments. (लिटर्जिकल संदर्भ में एक गंभीर या उत्साहजनक क्षण) • **Example:** The choir sang the sursum corda with reverence during the offertory section of the service. • **"Sursum-curving"** refers to something that curves upward, often used in botanical contexts to describe the direction of growth. (ऊपर की ओर मुड़ने वाला, विशेष रूप से वनस्पति संदर्भ में) • **Example:** The botanist observed the sursum-curving roots of the plant, which were adapting to the rocky soil. • In the correct sentence, "sursum-curving" is a homonym of "sursum" from the original statement, as it shares a similar spelling but differs in meaning. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1:** The musicologist analyzed the sursum tones in Gregorian chant. (संगीत विशेषज्ञ ने ग्रेगोरियन भजन में सुरसम सुरों का विश्लेषण किया।) • While this sentence is valid, it does not use the homonym of "sursum" but rather refers to the same liturgical context. • **Option 3:** The cantor raised his arms at the sursum. (गायक ने सुरसम पर अपने हाथ उठाए।) • This sentence also refers to the same liturgical meaning of "sursum" and does not represent a homonym. • **Option 4:** The choir followed the rubric leading into the sursum. (गाना मंडली ने सुरसम की ओर ले जाने वाले नियम का पालन किया।) • This option is related to the original liturgical meaning of "sursum" and does not use its homonym. 62:Tf78, The correct answer is **Option 1**.
